_comment: Copy to overseas.json (gitignored). Default verified=false keeps submit/generate offline (exit 2). Never put 43.x or drama.q-star.ink here. INTERNAL_WORKER_TOKEN stays in env / secrets files, not this JSON.
_how_to_verify: 1) Start: node dev/mock-google.mjs & node dev/mock-s3.mjs & npx wrangler pages dev public --port 8080 --ip 127.0.0.1 (in qstar-drama-intl-web-backend-dev @ 613a69f)
2) Set verified to true HERE, OR export QSTAR_OVERSEAS_VERIFIED=1
3) For loopback api_base_url also set QSTAR_OVERSEAS_TEST_BASE=1 (skill refuses non-intl hosts otherwise)
5) python3 scripts/drama_workflow.py submit <episode.json> <shot>  → Bearer claim dry-run
Do NOT set verified for production until overseas Pages deploy + secret put are done by Tiger.
